policy.integrity_rule: A published checksum mismatch blocks import. Never replace expected SHA256 with the observed value to mark a download valid.

datasets.name: IPN HandS

license.evidence: License section of the pinned IPN HandS README explicitly covers annotations and landmarks.

upstream_description.timeline: Frames extracted from original 640x480 videos with ffmpeg fps=30, NOT the original IPN Hand 320x240 frame timeline.
upstream_description.landmark_layout: 21 MediaPipe-order [x,y,z] points per hand; zero to two hands per frame. GT manually corrects x/y only, not z.

files.purpose: temporal labels, classes, splits and frame counts

check.note: Downloaded only to a temporary research directory. Archive metadata inspected without executing scripts or importing training data; CRC success does not resolve the upstream SHA256 mismatch.

files.purpose: preferred input: raw MediaPipe Hands predictions, including detection errors
optional corrected-2D reference, not deployment-equivalent model input
optional alternative baseline; not needed for first implementation

limitations: Preferred route is NOT ready for training until the annotation checksum discrepancy is resolved and input archives are verified.
Throw left/right are candidate command mappings, pending direction and gesture-semantic review; Open twice is not static palm wake, Grab is not static fist exit.
Preserve all 15 source classes; initial app proposal emits commands only for validated left/right classes and uses explicit UI/keyboard enable/stop.
Author MediaPipe predictions are not the project's pinned Hand Landmarker runtime. Record this domain/version difference; do not claim identical online/offline extraction.
Official lists are video splits. Audit participant overlap from metadata before claiming cross-subject evaluation; keep same participant/session/views in one group.
No original application enable/owner state, operator intent, command-response or exposure-latency ground truth. Predefined replay contexts must be labeled as simulated.

license.evidence: Official project page License section covers data and annotations.

files.purpose: original MP4 videos, five independent archives of 40 videos
original-release annotations and metadata; NOT IPN HandS annotations

check.note: Use the author's download page; no claim that this link is an automatic direct download.

Downloaded archive sizes, checksums and all splits still require validation.

datasets.name: HaGRIDv2

limitations: Static images cannot be repeated into artificial motion training sequences.
palm/fist are visible postures, not ground truth for wake/exit intent or hold duration.
